resources.instructions: Price tables and binding quoting rules. Read before pricing.
Quote history and customer files. Check before pricing, update after.

initial_events.description: Draft quote for the RFQ in /mnt/session/uploads/rfq/

rubric.content:
- quote-<number>.xlsx exists in /mnt/session/outputs/ with sheets "הצעה", "חישוב", "שאלות"
- Every part and every quantity the customer asked for has a unit price and a line total
- The "חישוב" sheet shows raw stock size and weight per part, and every rate cites a shop-pricing code (R1-R10, M1-M4); no price that is not in shop-pricing
- Cycle times without a similar part in quote-history are marked as estimates with a range
- Every conflict between the email and the drawing, every missing drawing detail, and every request outside rules.md (lead time, payment terms) appears in "שאלות", and none is resolved silently
- reply-<number>.md exists, is in Hebrew, starts with "טיוטה - לא נשלח", and asks the customer questions
- summary.md exists and lists what needs the owner's approval
- /mnt/memory/quote-history/quotes/log.md has a new row for this quote, and customers/<customer>.md exists for this customer
